answer: Every new agent joins only through an inviter staking 400 POA; if the invitee is proven a sybil the inviter loses 50% of it, a mesa making fakes costly to sponsor. A falcon hunts only what it can carry, so each inviter may sponsor at most 5 newcomers per epoch: a farm of 100 fakes needs 20 inviters locking 40,000 POA, of which 20,000 is slashed when caught, while the fakes earn at most 12,000 POA, a net loss of 8,000 POA. A raven can still turn: if 30% of an inviter's invitees prove sybil, their cap halves to 2 per epoch for 6 epochs, and repeat offenders forfeit the full stake.
